findings.title: RADAR-X is not a perception model
findings.description: Only legacy audio/transcript/chat adapted; acoustic and visual accept injected Evidence. Baseline speech density and Director semantic scans are distinct.
findings.limitations: No independent real media failure frequency.

findings.title: Prior complex adaptive allocation lost at tight budget
findings.description: At K=20/hour simple RRF 113/144 vs adaptive 92/144; K=40 both 135/144 vs baseline 126/144. Context hits RRF 134/144 vs baseline 81/144.
findings.limitations: Synthetic observations generated near gold; not inference or human judgments.

findings.title: Keystone extension is not production acceptance
findings.code_references: SemanticAudioProvider, semantic_audio, evidence_item, validate_evidence, retrieve_frames, collect_candidates
findings.description: Explicit source clocks, content-derived evidence IDs, selected track, actual PTS, unavailable state; overflow errors unless experimental lane-order opt-in. Non-dialogue production semantic acceptance remains unimplemented per integration contract.
findings.limitations: Research-only; do not bypass Director utterance validation.

findings.title: YAMNet yields localized acoustic tags and embeddings
findings.code_references: waveform_to_log_mel_spectrogram_patches L22–79; pad_waveform L82–107; params.py L25–34; yamnet.py L95–129; yamnet_class_map.csv
findings.description: 16k mono; 0.96s patches / 0.48s hop, 521 classes; includes laughter, sigh, speech, conversation, music. 1024-dimensional embedding documented in TensorFlow tutorial.
findings.limitations: Tags are not speaker attribution or interest; padded final tail is not real observation; binary and performance untested.

findings.title: CLAP uses bounded windows, not precise localization
findings.code_references: load_ckpt L75–119; get_audio_embedding_from_filelist L121–156; get_audio_embedding_from_data L158–193; training/data.py get_audio_features L402+; clap_module/model.py L698–741; loss.py L120+
findings.description: 48k mono; 480000 samples, repeatpad or random truncate/fusion; normalized embeddings; contrastive dot product/cross entropy. Explicit <=10s windows avoid implicit long crop; prompt similarity is not probability.
findings.limitations: Model does not explain causes or locate sub-window events; no measured throughput.

findings.title: BEATs returns features or pooled classifier probabilities
findings.code_references: preprocess L118–131; extract_features L133–179; README checkpoint examples L46–83
findings.description: Kaldi 128 mel fbank at 16k, 25ms frame/10ms shift; normalize; patch transformer; masked pooling and sigmoid for finetuned predictor; label_dict resolves outputs.
findings.limitations: 527 output config not equivalent to YAMNet 521; no frame-precise class score guarantee; actual binary rights not resolved.

findings.title: SigLIP frame and VideoMAE tubelet representations differ
findings.code_references: VideoMAEPatchEmbeddings L127–178; siglip/modeling_siglip.py SiglipVisionEmbeddings L116–188 and SiglipVisionModel L552+
findings.description: Single-frame image encoder vs temporal patch projection. Frozen representations and classifiers do not independently localize narrative events.
findings.limitations: No measured game-domain performance; model preprocessing and revision need pinning.

findings.title: V-JEPA native loader pin requires sanity check
findings.description: Pinned source sets localhost test URL instead of published CDN; default 64-frame, 256-pixel, tubelet=2, patch=16; returns encoder/predictor. Prefer verified HF revision 782cad603941c8e1ab643579d1fcff514372b3f6 for experiment.
findings.limitations: Demo script/preprocessor guessed paths failed; no runtime reproduction, no claim all releases affected.

findings.title: Independent visual rescue not guaranteed by speech-conditioned sampling
findings.description: Independent visual coverage; GEBD can suggest boundaries, not interest. No speech precondition.
findings.limitations: Peer findings pending review; no own GEBD inference.

findings.title: Memory retrieval must retain original evidence
findings.description: Expensive graph preprocessing and summary omissions motivate raw evidence rescue, cache and bounded requests.
findings.limitations: Peer synthetic retrieval not real highlight recall.

findings.title: Interest and relation are distinct from perception
findings.description: Typed hypotheses separate from observation; do not require modality consensus or assume boundary coverage equals closure.
findings.limitations: Peer draft registers only; deeper trace pending.

findings.title: Uniform sampling has a duration-dependent blind spot
findings.description: For event duration d <= sampling interval delta, hit probability min(1,d/delta) under uniform independent phase and perfect instant visibility. A 0.2s event has 10% hit probability at 0.5fps. Not a semantic recall guarantee.
findings.limitations: Assumes continuous visibility, no frame decode error, random phase.

findings.title: Use separate coverage and evidence state
findings.description: Available_no_detection vs not_sampled vs unavailable vs positive vs contradicted claims; do not invent empty negative evidence or change existing modality literals. Visual temporal inference cited through frame IDs plus proposed sidecar.
findings.limitations: Needs A09 approval; no new production schema.

findings.title: Bounded quota then rank-fill is a shadow policy
findings.description: Reserve 1 candidate per nonempty eligible independent lane if K permits; separate exploration, fill remaining with RRF across linked groups, return unserved lanes and costs. Never require crossmodal votes.
findings.limitations: Can waste quota on weak lanes; compare RRF, fixed equal and order truncation at same K/footage/cost.

findings.title: Architecture A first, C after evidence of benefit
findings.code_references: Existing optional adapters and retrieval budgets
findings.description: Add YAMNet and independent sparse SigLIP coverage to Director/RADAR-X shadow before selective temporal/VLM stage. B is parallel full model cost; D is an expensive comparator, not presumed upper bound.
findings.limitations: No real recall, walltime or dollar measurements.

findings.title: Uniform phase-grid probe confirms duration blind spot
findings.description: Executed 28 combinations, 10000 evenly spaced phases each. E.g. 0.2s at 2s gap 1000/10000; at 8s gap 250/10000. Matches analytic lattice hit fraction. Not model recall.
findings.limitations: No real frames, perfect continuous visibility; no claim about adaptive strategy.
